raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With more than one tokenizer worker (`--tokenizer-worker-num > 1`), both the Uvicorn and the Granian launch paths hand the server a fixed import string, `sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server:app`, and every worker process re-imports that module-level app. A package that embeds SGLang and registers extra routes on the app in the parent process never sees those routes in the workers, because each worker loads the bare SGLang app. There is currently no way to point the workers at an extended app without forking the launch code.

## Modifications

- Add `SGLANG_HTTP_SERVER_APP_PATH` to the `Envs` registry (HTTP server section), defaulting to `sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server:app`.
- Read it at both multi-worker launch sites in `http_server.py`: the Granian `target` and the `uvicorn.run(...)` import string.
- Document it next to the other HTTP-server variables in `docs/docs/references/environment_variables.mdx`.
- The single-worker path is unchanged and still passes the in-process `app` object; with the variable unset, behaviour is byte-for-byte the same as before.

Example: a package `my_pkg.server` that does `from sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server import app` and adds its own routes can now run `SGLANG_HTTP_SERVER_APP_PATH=my_pkg.server:app` with multiple tokenizer workers, and every worker serves the extended app.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable; no model or kernel code is touched.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable; the change only selects which ASGI app string the multi-worker server loads.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (`ruff format`/`ruff check`/`isort`/`codespell` at the pinned versions pass on both files.)
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (Verified by hand that the default, an environment override and `envs...override()` all reach `envs.SGLANG_HTTP_SERVER_APP_PATH.get()`; no new test, since the only testable contract is the pass-through of a string into `uvicorn.run`/Granian.)
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (Row added to the HTTP & gRPC Server table in `environment_variables.mdx`.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not applicable, see above.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

detail.title: [Feat] http_server: Make the multi-worker ASGI app path configurable

files.patch: @@ -2205,6 +2205,11 @@ MPS and does not read them. Uvicorn multiprocess supervisor per-worker health-check interval (seconds). 10 + + SGLANG_HTTP_SERVER_APP_PATH + ASGI import string (module:attr) that Uvicorn and Granian worker processes load when --tokenizer-worker-num is greater than 1. Point it at an app that extends the SGLang app with extra routes. + sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server:app + SGLANG_ENABLE_HEALTH_ENDPOINT_GENERATION Have the /health endpoint run a generation as part of the check.

@@ -2571,7 +2571,7 @@ def _run_granian_server(
 
     Server = GranianEmbeddedServer if tokenizer_worker_num == 1 else Granian
     target = (
-        app if tokenizer_worker_num == 1 else "sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server:app"
+        app if tokenizer_worker_num == 1 else envs.SGLANG_HTTP_SERVER_APP_PATH.get()
     )
     granian_kwargs = dict(
         target=target,
@@ -2836,7 +2836,7 @@ async def _run_with_ssl_refresh():
                 )
             else:
                 uvicorn.run(
-                    "sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server:app",
+                    envs.SGLANG_HTTP_SERVER_APP_PATH.get(),
                     host=get_serving().host,
                     port=get_serving().port,
                     root_path=get_serving().fastapi_root_path,

@@ -338,6 +338,9 @@ class Envs:
     # Uvicorn multiprocess supervisor pings each worker on this interval; default 5s is
     # too short when many workers cold-start and load tokenizers in parallel.
     SGLANG_UVICORN_WORKER_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT = EnvInt(10)
+    # ASGI import string that multi-worker Uvicorn and Granian processes load;
+    # point it at an app that extends `http_server.app` with extra routes.
+    SGLANG_HTTP_SERVER_APP_PATH = EnvStr("sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server:app")
     SGLANG_ENABLE_HEALTH_ENDPOINT_GENERATION = EnvBool(True)
     SGLANG_EXPOSE_OWN_ENV_VARS = EnvBool(False)
     SGLANG_DIAG_BYPASS_HEALTH_GENERATE = EnvBool(False)
